exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery, operative vaginal delivery, cesarean section)
finding: While there was a significant decline in sexual function at 3 and 6 months postpartum, sexual functioning returned to baseline pre-pregnancy levels by 12 months postpartum, regardless of mode of delivery, perineal injuries, or peripartum expectations.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery and perineal trauma do not influence women's postpartum sexual function.
